item.title: Faeces smeared on seats and structure of bus shelter, 22nd November
item.description:
Some disgusting individuals have smeared faeces all along the seats & advertising board at the bus shelter at stop BV. They have actually used it to write something over existing graffiti. I made 3 attempts to report it online to TfL, but due to technical difficulties, my report wouldn't go through. Now that I'm back home, I've just spoken to one of their staff on the phone who has confirmed that the matter will be investigated ASAP. I'm concerned that anyone with sight impairment may not see the state of the seats, and anyone needing to sit will be in danger of getting foul waste on their hands or clothing. The bus stop will be very busy in the morning with passengers going to work, school etc, so it's imperative that this mess is cleaned up immediately & the area disinfected, too.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Roseacre Road, Welling, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
